Optional local browser runtime (not inside the Tera setup executable).
Camoufox 158.0-beta.40: https://github.com/daijro/camoufox/releases/tag/v158.0-beta.40
Source: https://github.com/daijro/camoufox (MPL-2.0; see upstream/component notices)
Windows x64 ZIP SHA256: 2d3e33207c2d5853e817e8317f0e33124ffb7054bd5102c8b84546e3d15a6447
Node.js 24.22.1: https://github.com/nodejs/node/tree/v24.22.1
Executable SHA256: 6d75619e8720161bb0e8c5617bcf90384b48a920b9182ec6e9d52f11f83a8e84
Official Node LICENSE is retained as Node-LICENSE.txt in the runtime.
Playwright Core 1.62.1: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright (Apache-2.0)
Original LICENSE/NOTICE and package sources remain in playwright-core/.
uBlock Origin 1.75.0: https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/ublock-origin/
Source: https://github.com/gorhill/uBlock (GPL-3.0)
Official signed XPI SHA256: 5b74415860456370644bd80f16125e865b0e6c356bb5dfcfb84069967eaa5287
The original add-on payload is extracted without changes into addons/ublock/.

Tera's launcher configuration restores selected protection preferences. This is
not verification that every stock Firefox protection backend works in this fork.
No Camoufox Python SDK, fpgen model or paid verification service is installed.
The helper/installer do not automatically update this runtime. For reproducible
local installation run install_camoufox_runtime.py --help and supply local assets.

Evidence: 3/3 for recorded asset hashes and inspected versions; 2/3 for full
upstream protection equivalence, which has not been runtime-verified.
